measurement: close before print to close after first full session following

names.notes: Reported after close 2026-08-19: EPS -$2.26 vs -$1.47 consensus (miss), revenue $149.6M roughly in line with the company's own $140-160M guide but ~33% below the stale $223.6M aggregator consensus the panel had flagged as unreliable pre-print; FY2027 guide kept gross margin negative. Stock fell as much as ~17% in extended/after-hours trading before closing -9.42% on the first full session. The panel's specific red-team reversal case (an ~80%-of-float short squeeze repeating the May pattern) did not fire this time -- a genuinely worse-guided print broke the squeeze setup instead of triggering it. The Neutral / No Edge call scores as a hit under the below-expected-move convention (|9.42%| < 15.4% unsigned expected, and within the 7.7-24.6% band), but it is a hit that made no directional claim. The stage-2 preliminary read (-20, bearish) called the actual direction correctly; the seven-persona panel, shown the identical Phase-0 anchors, hedged to no edge. n=1, not enough to draw a conclusion about panel value, but the first data point favours the cheap read over the expensive one.

Reported after close 2026-08-19: non-GAAP EPS $0.84 vs $0.71 consensus (beat), revenue $436.2M vs $430.5M consensus (beat), core revenue +16% y/y. A clean beat-and-raise-adjacent quarter that the stock essentially shrugged off (-0.65%), against a mild preliminary bullish lean (+10). Move this small is close to noise -- scored as a miss under strict sign convention, but the more useful read is that the +10 preliminary score correctly flagged low conviction (a name with a real beat and a near-flat reaction is exactly what a low-magnitude score should predict).

Reported before open 2026-08-20: quarterly profit fell ~75% y/y on a 75% jump in AI capex, missing EPS by roughly 20% (RMB8.52 vs RMB10.72 est.), but revenue rose 9% y/y and cloud revenue rose 45% with AI products posting triple-digit growth for a 12th straight quarter. Shares gapped down as much as 4-5% in early trading on the profit miss, then reversed through the session on the cloud/AI growth story to close +1.26% -- a clean intraday reversal that a close-to-close number alone would hide. Preliminary score (+10) called the closing direction correctly, though the intraday low would have scored it a miss.

Reported before open 2026-08-20: adjusted pretax loss of $2M (guidance had called for breakeven or better), EPS -$0.70 vs -$0.56 consensus (miss), revenue $706M slightly below the $723.5M estimate though above the midpoint of the company's own guide. Stock opened down ~6%, fell as much as -15.2% intraday (to $108.25) before recovering more than half the drawdown to close -7.47%. Preliminary score (-15) called the direction correctly; this was the thinnest-evidence dossier of the four (`evidence: thin` at triage, no implied-move anchor) and still got the sign right.
